title: Purchases on a darknet market paid on to a vendor less a commission
summary: Several customers each buy small amounts of bitcoin and send them to a deposit address of a market. The market releases each payment to a vendor's wallet less a commission.

basis.note: The report says that the buyer pays the market, which holds the funds and pays the vendor less its commission. The payment sizes are assumed.

parties.label: a customer who buys from the market
the deposit address of the market

basis.note: No source read for this part gives the share of market deposit addresses that a screening tool has already labelled. The value means that 1 address in 2 is labelled.

steps.say: Each customer buys bitcoin and sends small payments to the deposit address of the market.

basis.note: The report says that buyers pay the market, which holds the funds in escrow. The deposit address, the number of customers, the count of 1 to 4 payments, the sizes of 40 to 600 pounds, the waits and the use of bitcoin are assumed.

steps.say: The market releases each payment to the vendor's wallet, less a commission.

basis.note: The report says that the market pays the vendor less its commission. The commission of 3% to 8% and the wait are assumed. The commission remains at the deposit address, which is the market's.
